Commentary.Commentary: Right then, a run-fest comes to a close. Paul Stirling set the stage on fire with his remarkable knock and powered Ireland to a total which eventually proved to be enough to edge out the home team. The action now shifts to St Kitts where both the remaining T20Is of this series will be played. The first one is on 18th January at 1800 local (2200 GMT). Do join us for the coverage. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Paul Stirling, says it was a really good pitch and they put up a good score and they felt they were in the game throughout. Further adds the Windies were up with the rate all the time, it was touch and go throughout and they enjoyed the game and is happy to get over the line. Also says, you have different mindsets in a T20 game as there is more freedom in this format. Ends by saying they needed to keep taking wickets, it is a daunting task watching those big men come in but they tried to take wickets at regular basis.

Let's talk about the last 4 overs of the run chase. It was pulsating. With 45 needed off 24 balls, Ireland started to gain control. They even went on to get a firm grip once George Dockrell bowled a 2-run 17th over, making the required equation - 43 off 18 balls. Just when we thought that Ireland will dictate terms, Nicholas Pooran and Sherfane Rutherford smashes Barry McCarthy for 27 runs in an over to nearly put the chase to bed. 16 off 2 overs is pretty straightforward to achieve in this format but West Indies somehow managed to threw it away. Craig Young came up with a superb penultimate over where he removed Pooran and gave away only 3 runs. 9 out of 10 times, a team will score 13 runs in the final over with Dwayne Bravo and Sherfane Rutherford in the middle. But that didn't happen this time around. Joshua Little kept his calm and bowled a pinpoint last over to take Ireland over the line.

It was a see-saw battle in literal sense! The pendulum kept swinging from one side to the another and there was never a moment that a team entirely felt in control. Chasing 209 was never going to be easy but given the firepower that West Indies possessed in their batting attack, the run chase was always on. They initiated decently in the Powerplay, not going hammer and tongs like the Irishmen and laid the foundation. Evin Lewis once again looked in supreme touch but once he got out, Ireland started to grow in the match. However, Kieron Pollard and Shimron Hetmyer's counter-punch kept the visitors on the edge of their seats.

What a nail-biter! Ufff...that went right down to the wire and eventually Ireland managed to hang onto this match by the skin of their teeth. They needed this win after getting thumped in the ODI series.

A swing and a miss! IRELAND HAVE WON THE FIRST GAME OF THE SERIES! It is a full ball outside off, Walsh looks to heave it over the leg side but misses. Pin-drop silence here in the stadium and rightly so, their team has lost by 4 runs!
Khary Pierre walks in for the final ball of the game. Hayden Walsh to face the final ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bravo gone and Ireland are ecstatic. They are on the verge of upsetting a top team in the international arena. Good length ball on off, Bravo looks to heave it away to the leg side but it takes the top edge and goes towards deep mid-wicket. Gareth Delany comes under it and takes a simple catch. 5 required from the final ball.
Good length ball down the leg side, Bravo looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the leg side. Walsh wants the single but Bravo sends him back.

Two taken! Excellent running! That was a run out though had the bowler collected it, pressure though gets the better of him. It is full and on middle, this is hit down to long on. They taken one and then go for the second. The fielder fires it to the bowler who fails to collect it.
SIX! Bravo using all his experience. Brilliant! Good length ball on off, Bravo hammers it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Hayden Walsh is in at no. 8. He will be at the non-striker's end though.

OUT! CAUGHT! Is that the end of the game? Rutherford gone and Little has done the trick. Good length ball on off, Rutherford looks to hammer it over the long on fielder for a biggie but does not time it well. It goes towards long on and Dockrell settles himself under it. He takes a simple catch and West Indies are in trouble. 13 needed from 5 balls.
Joshua Little to bowl the final over of the game. 12 for him to defend.

Excellent nut to end with from Young. Just three runs from it and a wicket. Full delivery outside off, Rutherford drives it down to long off for a single. 13 required from the last over. Who will take the game away? Will it be the hosts or will it be the Irishmen?
Short delivery on middle, Bravo pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Finds the fielder again. Good length delivery on off, Bravo drives only to find the cover fielder.
The fielders are nice and close! A single saved there! Fuller and around off, this is driven to the man at covers.
Dwayne Bravo replaces Pooran out in the middle. He was brilliant with the ball. Can he finish off well with the bat as well?

OUT! CAUGHT! Is there another twist in this game now? A short delivery around the body, Pooran pulls it but hits it flat, it goes towards deep square leg where Delany takes a nice catch. Pooran gone, 15 needed in 10 with a new batter on strike, Ireland have a sniff here.
Leading edge but safe! A low full toss on the pads, Rutherford looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat a touch early. It goes off the leading edge towards mid off for a run.
Craig Young to bowl the penultimate over of the game. 3-0-28-1 so far from him.

FOUR! That is an innocuous delivery and it has been put away with disdain. A full toss outside off, Pooran drives it through the point region. The fielder chases after it from deep cover and dives but fails to stop it. What an over for West Indies! 27 runs coming off it and the required equation is quite simple now - 16 needed off 12 balls.
SIX! Thrashed! This over has turned things again in the favour of the hosts. Full delivery on middle, Pooran hammers it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery outside off, Pooran prods forward and lifts it over the cover fielder for a boundary. The fielder comes across but fails to cut it off.
Just evades the fielder! Full delivery outside off, Rutherford drives it uppishly but it is just wide of the cover fielder and the ball goes to the deep. The batters take a single.

SIX! Colossal! And let me tell you, he has hit it with one hand. Just shows the power of this guy. WOW! It is slightly short and outside off, Rutherford drags it, his one hand comes off the handle but it still goes over the mid-wicket fence. 12 from the first two balls. The game is back in the Windies' favor.

SIX! That releases the pressure somewhat! A six from the first ball. 37 needed in 17 now. Barry misses the yorker by a little. It ends up being a in the slot delivery. Rutherford lofts it over the long off fence.
Barry McCarthy returns now. 3-0-28-0 are his numbers so far.

Three plays and misses in a row! Floated ball outside off, Pooran looks to drive again but fails to connect. A brilliant over comes to an end from George Dockrell. Just two runs have come from it. 43 more required from the last three overs.
Excellent bowling from Dockrell! Very full delivery outside off, Pooran moves to the off side again and then attempts to drive it through covers. He fails to get any bat on it though.
BEATEN! Quicker delivery outside off, Pooran moves to the off side to play it through the line but misses.
Floated ball outside off, Sherfane pushes it down to long off for a single.
Yorker! It is bowled outside off, Rutherford looks to dig it out but misses it.
Flighted ball outside off, Pooran drives it to long off for a single.
George Dockrell is back into the attack! A big gamble this, two left-handers and on comes the left-arm spinner. This over could probably decide the match.
On middle and leg, Pooran whips it to the leg side for a single. 45 more needed in 24 balls.
Good length ball on middle, Rutherford whips it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Very full delivery on middle, Pooran works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Pooran looks to drive but misses to get any bat on it.
Short delivery on middle, Rutherford pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Poor delivery and rightly put away! Short delivery down the leg side, Rutherford just helps it on its way over the backward square leg region for a biggie.
Craig Young returns. 2-0-18-1 from him so far.
Flatter delivery outside off, Rutherford punches it down to long off for a single. Just 4 runs and wicket from the over. A brilliant one for Ireland.
Floated on off, Pooran pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flatter one outside off, Pooran cuts it to the deep point fielder for a single.
Sherfane Rutherford joins Nicholas Pooran out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Yes, Singh has managed to strike and it's the wicket of the big fish. A leg break delivery, that too from an off spinner. It is bowled on middle and leg, on the shorter side, Pollard looks to hammer it straight down the ground but it is not hit properly. It goes to wide of the long on fielder. Dockrell comes across, slides and takes it, losing his cap in the process. 59 required from 34 balls. Can the Irishmen win it from here?
Flatter one on middle, Pollard plays it back to the bowler.
Simi Singh to bowl out. 3-0-32-0 are his numbers so far. Can he strike at least once in his final over?
Ends it brilliantly! 4 dots in a row. Just the five from it. Shorter and outside off, it is guided to point.
Three dots in a row! One more slower short ball outside off, Pooran is early in the pull shot and he misses. So this has been a good over so far. He needs to end it well.

Ouch! That must have hurt! A good slower one on off, it is behind a length. Pooran goes down one one knee and looks to slog but misses to get hit on the body. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Pitches it a little ahead this time and it skids through. Pooran keeps it out.

FOUR! That bursts through the hands of the fielder! It was hit so hard. 150 up for West Indies. Shorter and on the body, Pooran powers it through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and dives but the ball goes through his hands and finds the boundary.
A slower one outside off, Pollard waits for it and guides it through point for one.
Joshua Little is back on. 2-0-16-1 so far from him.
Full toss on middle, Pollard plays it towards long on for a single. 19 from the over and West Indies are on the charge!

SIX! Back-to-back biggies for Pollard and he has raced to 29 off just 11 balls. Floated ball outside off, Pollard lunges and thrashes it over the long off fielder for another maximum. The required rate goes below 10 now.
SIX! Walloped! That went way into the stands. Cannot bowl that length to Pollard. Floated on off, right in the arc, Pollard hammers it over the long on region for a biggie.
Floated on middle, Pooran comes down the track and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Short one outside off, Pooran punches it to covers and takes a single.
WIDE! Another one! Fullish delivery way outside off, Pollard looks to drive but misses. The keeper too fails to collect, allowing the batters to steal a bye.
WIDE! This is not good bowling! Flatter one way outside off, Pollard leaves it alone. Wided by the umpire.
On middle, this time Pollard just works it towards square leg for a single. 12 from the over, another decent one for the Windies. 83 more needed in 48 balls.

FOUR! That went like a bullet! Simi loops this one full and around off, Pollard just drills it down the ground. Simi gets down and tries to field but the ball sneaks through and goes to the long off fence.
SIX! Slammed over! A poor ball from Simi. It is short and around off. Pollard is not going to miss out. He goes on the back foot and sends is sailing over deep mid-wicket for a massive biggie.
Fires it on the pads, Pooran pushes it towards long on for a single to get off the mark.
Another dot ball. It is again on middle and a quicker one. Pooran can only push it back to the bowler.
Floats a quicker one on middle, Pooran pushes it back to the bowler.
Nicholas Pooran is the new man in for West Indies. Simi Singh returns with the ball. 2-0-20-0 are his numbers so far.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time it carries to Balbirnie. Dockrell redeems himself as well. Tossed up ball outside off, Hetmyer looks to power it over long off  but fails to get the elevation and distance on it. It goes towards long off where Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, runs a little ahead and dives to take a good catch, just inches above the ground.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

Just short! Almost! Flighted one outside off, Hetmyer lunges and then tries to lift it over long off but does not get the required distance on it. Balbirnie attempts to catch it by leaning forward but it drops in front of him.
Floated on middle, Hetmyer plays it back to the bowler.
SIX! Powerfully hit! Dockrell is being taken apart. Full delivery outside off, Lewis hammers it over the long off region for a biggie.
Flatter delivery on middle, Pollard works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
George Dockrell returns. 1-0-21-0 from him so far.

On a length ball on the pads, Pollard looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls to square leg and the batters manage to take a leg bye. 105/2 at the halfway mark are the Windies. 104 more needed in the final 10 overs.
WIDE! BOUNCER! It is bowled down the leg side, Pollard lets it go to the keeper. Wide signaled.
On off, pushed to deep point for another run.
Length ball on off, Hetmyer pushes it to the cover fielder.
SIX! Brilliant! Hetmyer is known for these kinds of shots. Full delivery on off, Hetmyer hammers it over the long on region for a biggie. 100 up for the hosts, still needing 107 runs from 63 balls.
Back of a length ball on off, Pollard punches it down to long off for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Pollard works it to deep square leg and picks up a couple before the fielder comes across and cleans it up.

Skipper Kieron Pollard replaces Evin Lewis out in the middle. He has promoted himself in the batting order, maybe to stay with Hetmyer and get the best out of him. Barry McCarthy is back on now. 2-0-17-0 are his figures so far.

OUT! In the air... and another good catch by an Ireland player! This time it is Tector! Lewis is out of here shortly after getting to his fifty. A much-needed wicket for the visitors as the second wicket partnership was going along really well. It is a length ball around off, Lewis looks to go over covers but ends up slicing it towards the man in the deep. Tector there runs to his left, dives and takes it nicely. 116 needed in 66 balls.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! It indeed is pitching outside leg. Ireland lose their review. It was more in hope I believe, they are desperate for a wicket and probably that was the reason they took it. It hits the pad of Hetmyer as he tries to flick. A huge appeal by the bowler but the umpire shakes his head. The Irish skipper signals the 'T'. Time for the replays and it shows the on-field call is the right one.
A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down. The Ireland skipper reviews. Seems to be pitching outside leg.
Another good delivery! Fuller in length and around middle, not giving the batter room to free his arms. Lewis pushes it towards covers and takes one.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Hetmyer works it through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Lewis pushes it wide of the fielder at covers and takes one.
Craig Young returns. 1-0-14-0 are his numbers so far.
Floated on middle, Lewis looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge of his bat and rolls towards mid-wicket. The batters manage to take a single. 21 runs have come from Dockrell's first over.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
WIDE! Flatter one outside off, Lewis shoulders arms and the umpire signals it a wide.

SIX! Another one! Dockrell is not having a good start to this innings. Flatter one outside off, Lewis lunges and hammers it over the long off region for a biggie. 50 up for Lewis, his 6th in T20Is. Continues his great run against the Irishmen.

SIX! Short delivery on middle, Lewis rocks on his back foot and pulls it with disdain over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum. This is probably the wrong end for Dockrell as there is a strong wind blowing towards that side.
Flatter one outside off, Hetmyer cuts it to deep point for a single.
SIX! Welcome into the attack, Mr. Dockrell, says Hetmyer! Floated ball on middle, Hetmyer bends on his knee and slog sweeps it over the deep square leg region for a biggie.
George Dockrell is on now.
On a length on middle, Hetmyer works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. A 5-run over by Barry!
Full delivery outside off, Lewis drives it to the deep cover region for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Hetmyer works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower length ball down the leg side, Lewis looks to paddle but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls wide of the keeper and the batters steal a leg bye.
On off, Lewis lunges and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Slower delivery on the pads, Hetmyer flicks it to deep square leg and picks up a run.
Barry McCarthy is back on. 1-0-13-0 from him so far.
Short delivery on off, Lewis pushes it to point. Just 7 from the last over of the Powerplay, Windies are 63/1, 30 runs behind Ireland at this stage.
Short delivery on middle, Hetmyer pulls it wide of mid on and takes a single.
On a length on off, Hetmyer pushes it down to mid off.
Back of a length ball on off, Lewis guides it to point and crosses over for a single.
FOUR! Cannot bowl there! Lewis loves playing that shot. Short of a length delivery on off, Lewis camps back and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Shimron works it to deep square leg to get off the mark with a single.
EDGY FOUR! Third boundary in the over! Shorter in length and outside off, Lewis goes hard after it. The ball though flies off the outside edge and goes to the third man fence.
Lewis misses out there! A slower ball, it is a dipping full toss. Lewis strokes it towards cover. Two dots in a row.

Yes, no, yes, no, confusion but no harm done! This one is a length ball, Lewis pushes it towards mid off. He wants a run, Hetmyer hesitates, Lewis stops and then both the batters go back to their respective ends.

FOUR! This one is right off the middle! A little width on offer outside off and Lewis makes him pay. He smashes it through covers and it races away to the fence. 50 up for the Windies. 10 from the first three balls.

In the air... safe! Just out of reach! One more full ball around off, Lewis swings again but this time only manages to slice it over mid off. Kevin O'Brien runs after the ball but fails to reach it. Two taken.
FOUR! Up and over! Welcome into the attack, Young! Fuller and on off, Lewis makes room and lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary. Another over starts off with a boundary.
Craig Young is into the attack now.

Just short! Short of a length ball on off, Lewis looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards mid-wicket. Luckily for Lewis, the ball falls short of the onrushing fielder. The batters manage to take a single. 9 runs and a wicket from the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Poor delivery to follow up the wicket! Full delivery down the leg side, Lewis flicks it down the fine leg region for a boundary.
Shimron Hetmyer walks in at no. 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch! A screamer from George Dockrell! Unbelievable. Ireland are ecstatic and rightly so. A length delivery on off, Simmons opens up with the intention to power it over mid off but loses his shape badly. He ends up slicing it over the cover region. George Dockrell comes across from deep point, sees from the corner of his eye that Simi Singh is running in from the circle. George though does well to keep his eyes and concentration on the ball and dives forward to complete a stunner of a catch. He jumps and starts celebrating. A good little knock from Simmons comes to an end.
Good fielding! This is fuller and outside off, Simmons guides it towards point. The fielder dives to his right and stops it.
FOUR! That is just placed! Brilliant shot, beautifully timed. It is slightly fuller and around off, Simmons leans into it and just creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Joshua Little into the attack now.
Floated one outside off, Lewis pushes it to point. Big, big over for the Windies. 16 runs have come from it.
Loopy delivery outside off, Lewis pushes it back to the bowler.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
WIDE! Flatter one outside off, Lendl lets it go to the keeper. A wide signaled.
SIX! Simmons is taking on Simi Singh! 14 already from the over. Floated on middle, Simmons smashes it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.

FOUR! Thrashed! This is even better! Very full delivery on off, Simmons hammers it straight back past the bowler and into the fence. Not easy to hit those fullish deliveries but Simmons still manages to do so. Nearly took the umpire along with his shot.
FOUR! A rank long hop! Short delivery on off, Simmons hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.

SIX! Hammered! Short ball on off, Lewis rocks on his back foot and whacks it over the deep mid-wicket region for the first biggie of the innings. 13 runs have come from the over, an expensive one for the Irishmen.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Lendl drives it down to long on for a single.
Good length ball on off, Simmons stands tall and defends it out.
McCarthy dishes a length ball outside off, Simmons leaves the ball alone.
Good length ball on the pads, Evin works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! Short delivery on off, Lewis pulls it over the mid on fielder and goes into the fence. The fielder chases after it but fails to do so. First one in this innings.
WIDE! False start. McCarthy goes for a short ball first up but the line is not right. It is down the leg side. Lewis looks to pull but misses. Called a wide.
Pace from the other end as Barry McCarthy to bowl now.

Overthrows but no extra run taken! Flatter one on middle, Lewis punches it to cover and takes off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses it. The ball rolls to the deep square leg region but the batters decide against taking the second.
Floated on middle, Simmons works it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Lendl gently pushes it to the cover fielder.
Flat one outside off, Lewis punches it off the back foot towards mid off, Singh comes across, dives but fails to stop it. The batters take a single.
Simmons and West Indies are underway! Flatter one on off, Simmons pushes it to long on for a single.
Singh starts with a floated ball on middle. No spin on it though. Simmons solidly defends it back to the bowler.

The run chase is all set to get underway! The Ireland players are already out in the middle with Evin Lewis and Lendl Simmons, the designated West Indian openers following them. Simi Singh will start for the visitors.
